title: 第7章 被困山脉第8章 强大灵兽
content_zh:
“我的行踪已经暴露，得换个地方继续闭关修炼！”
牧帆立即动身离开。
这一次，他打算找机会直接远离清风城，等修为恢复再回来报仇。
几天前的他太弱了，容易被抓住，所以才躲入蛮牛山脉中，现在他的实力有所提升，一般的对手已经威胁不到他。
目前的牧帆，黄武境七重，已经不畏惧任何黄武境武者，但是牧族的族长和三大长老，可都是玄武境。
牧唐都死了，牧族肯定会派出更强大的长老来。
牧帆很清楚，现在的他和玄武境硬碰，还很勉强。
大境界的差距，没那么容易跨越。
然而牧帆刚出蛮牛山脉没几步，就看到一百多人朝着山脉奔来，脸色瞬间一变，急忙躲藏起来。
为首的，居然是宋族的一位玄武境长老！
这长老，名宋时于，是宋族六大玄武境高手之一。
是了，牧族为了对付牧帆，便拉进来了宋族。
牧建阳对宋族高层直说了，宋族和他们一同对付牧帆之事都已经被牧帆知晓，并且牧帆重修武道，天赋更胜以往，扬言要灭了宋族和牧族。
为了让宋族出大力，牧建阳只能这么说，将牧帆说得很牛逼。
牧建阳不知道的是，他所说的这些话，都是真的！
牧帆还真就知道了一切，并且有《至尊神诀》，天赋也更胜以往。
宋族不敢赌，他们非常清楚牧帆曾经的天赋有多厉害，所以只能发动人手，全力追杀牧帆。
知晓牧帆可能在三座山脉中，宋族便也派出三路人马！
蛮牛镇的人基本逃回了镇子，刚刚逃出去的牧常也已经在他们之中，所以宋时于等人已经知晓牧帆就在山里，因此都是杀气腾腾。
宋时于穿着一身灰袍，留有长须，看起来五六十岁的样子，修为有玄武境一重，他眼眸扫过一眼山脉，下令道：“所有人，互相之间隔着四五丈，一旦发现牧帆的身影，立即汇报！”

“是！”
众多武者，都是恭敬的点头。
这种地毯式搜寻，牧帆根本躲不了，只能不断的往后退去。
望着地面上的一具具尸体，宋时于神色微沉，“这个牧帆，心狠手辣，绝对不能留，否则日后还真会成为宋族的大患！”
就连牧族的人都被杀，更不用说他们宋族的人了。
“没想到牧帆这个废人，居然还真重新修炼了。”
一个中年男子很是不理解。
他是宋茗，黄武境九重。
“牧帆此子不一般，当初就应该直接杀了，斩草除根！”
宋时于低声道。
“武脉都废了，谁又能想到，牧帆还能修炼呢！
content_en:
"My whereabouts have been exposed, I have to move to another place to continue practicing in seclusion!"
Mu Fan immediately left.
This time, he planned to find an opportunity to stay away from Qingfeng City and come back for revenge after his cultivation level recovered.
A few days ago, he was too weak and easily caught, so he hid in the Manniu Mountains. Now his strength has improved, and ordinary opponents can no longer threaten him.
The current Mu Fan, who is at the seventh level of the Huangwu Realm, is no longer afraid of any Huangwu Realm warriors, but the patriarch and the three elders of the Mu Clan are all at the Xuanwu Realm.
Since Mu Tang is dead, the Mu Clan will definitely send more powerful elders.
Mu Fan knew very well that it was still difficult for him to face the Xuanwu realm head-on.
The gap between big realms is not so easy to bridge.
However, just a few steps out of the Manniu Mountains, Mu Fan saw more than a hundred people running towards the mountains. His expression changed instantly and he hurriedly hid.
The leader is actually a Xuanwu Realm elder from the Song Clan!
This elder, named Song Shiyu, is one of the six masters of the Xuanwu Realm of the Song clan.
Yes, in order to deal with Mu Fan, the Mu Clan brought in the Song Clan.
Mu Jianyang told the top officials of the Song clan that Mu Fan had already known about the Song clan's cooperation with them in dealing with Mu Fan, and that Mu Fan had retrained in martial arts and was more talented than before, threatening to destroy the Song clan and the Mu clan.
In order to get the Song clan to do their best, Mu Jianyang could only say this, saying that Mu Fan was very awesome.
What Mu Jianyang didn't know was that what he said was all true!
Mufan really knows everything, and has the "Supreme Divine Art", and his talent is better than before.
The Song people didn't dare to gamble. They knew very well how talented Mu Fan was, so they could only mobilize their manpower to pursue Mu Fan with all their strength.
Knowing that Mu Fan might be in the three mountain ranges, the Song clan also sent three groups of people!
Most of the people in Manniu Town fled back to the town, and Mu Chang, who had just escaped, was already among them, so Song Shiyu and others already knew that Mu Fan was in the mountains, so they were all murderous.
Song Shiyu was wearing a gray robe with a long beard. He looked to be in his fifties or sixties, and his cultivation was at the level of the Xuanwu Realm. He glanced at the mountains and ordered: "Everyone is separated by four or five feet from each other. Once you find Mu Fan, report it immediately!"
"Yes!"
Many warriors nodded respectfully.
Mu Fan couldn't hide from this carpet-like search and could only keep retreating.
Looking at the corpses on the ground, Song Shiyu's expression darkened, "This Mu Fan is cruel and ruthless, and we must not keep him, otherwise he will really become a serious problem for the Song clan in the future!"
Even the people of the Mu tribe were killed, not to mention the people of their Song tribe.
"I didn't expect that Mu Fan, a loser, would actually start practicing again."
A middle-aged man didn't understand.
He is Song Ming, at the ninth level of Huangwu Realm.
"Mu Fan is an unusual kid. He should have been killed directly from the beginning, eradicating the roots!"
Song Shiyu whispered.
"With my martial arts gone, who would have thought that Mu Fan could still practice!
